title: The Fowl Players of Perryville at Madigan's Waterfront- Murder Mystery Dinner- "Goatman, Go!!"
name: The Fowl Players of Perryville at Madigan's Waterfront- Murder Mystery Dinner- "Goatman, Go!!"
description:
Help us crack the case! Join us on Sunday, Oct 25th, for our next murder mystery , presented in conjunction with The Fowl Players of Perryville. Your ticket gives you access to the event and a wonderful three course dinner including soda, coffee and tea.
COME DRESSED FOR THE COSTUME CONTEST!!!
First Course: House Salad
Second Course: Your choice of NY Strip steak OR Salmon with a lemon butter sauce OR Chicken with a Parmesan Peppercorn cheese sauce OR Vegan Chef's Choice
Third Course: NY Style cheesecake with chocolate mousse! (Vegans will have fresh fruit cup)
Doors open at 5. Please arrive no later than 5:30 so that you can enjoy your meal
TIn 1971, a young couple, while parking on Lover’s Lane between a top secret government research facility (The United States Federal Agricultural Research Center) and Bockstraten Farm, a local goat farm, is startled by an unusual creature, a “Goat Man”. They are startled so much, that in a panicked attempt to escape, the boyfriend, Monty Raye, a maintenance worker at the Research Center ends up driving his car through a security fence and getting it stuck. Eyla White, (Raye’s girlfriend) a budding young crime journalism student from the University of Maryland decides to investigate the strange sightings and to see if the rumors of strange experiments are true, while Raye tries to get his car unstuck so they can go home. Meanwhile, Dr. Sainz X Piermont, lead researcher at the lab is feuding with Farmer JS Bockstraten owner of the goat farm, but why? Is this “Goat Man” a creature from another world, or a product of a sinister genetic experiment gone awry? What is really going on in that lab, or on the goat farm?
Join us for a slightly improv, corny dad jokes to the max mad cap comedic murder mystery. If you love groaning puns, this is the place for you!
PLEASE NOTE: This event takes place upstairs and is only accessible by stairs, we do not have an elevator.

title: Open to the Public | PWC Trails & Blueways Council Meetings
name: Open to the Public | PWC Trails & Blueways Council Meetings
description:
Open to the Public
PWC Trails & Blueways Council monthly meetings are generally held at 6:30pm on the fourth Tuesday of every month, except when adjusted for holidays or other special circumstances.
Meeting location:
George Hellwig Administration Building
14420 Bristow Road Manassas, VA 20112
A simple majority of Council members shall constitute a quorum. Agendas are usually available the Friday prior to the meeting.
https://pwcparks.info/trailsandblueways
The Prince William County Trails and Blueways Council is an advisory council established by the Prince William Board of County Supervisors to provide services for the development of trails and blueways in Prince William County. The mission of the Council is to advise the Prince William County Department of Parks & Recreation and the Board of County Supervisors on the development of a countywide trails and blueways system in Prince William County.
The Council consists of 16 members appointed by the Board of County Supervisors (two representatives for each Board member). Each appointee shall be an individual from the community-at-large and shall live within Prince William County.
